title: Low-Level Model Operations
summary: This module provides foundational functionalities for model creation, quantization, MLX model execution, cache management, image generation, and neural network components. It underpins the core model serving and management capabilities.

nodes.label: Model Creation & Quantization
nodes.title: Model Creation & Quantization
nodes.description: Handles the creation of models from various sources and applies quantization techniques to optimize their size and performance.

nodes.label: MLX Runner & Cache Management
nodes.title: MLX Runner & Cache Management
nodes.description: Manages the execution of MLX models, including efficient key-value cache handling and snapshotting for conversational context.

nodes.label: Image Generation Engine
nodes.title: Image Generation Engine
nodes.description: Provides the core logic for generating images using various models and handles HTTP requests for image completion.

nodes.label: Neural Network Components
nodes.title: Neural Network Components
nodes.description: Implements fundamental neural network layers and operations, focusing on recurrent mechanisms and gated delta networks.

nodes.label: Tool Registry & Websearch
nodes.title: Tool Registry & Websearch
nodes.description: Manages a registry of available tools and provides functionality for executing them, including web search capabilities.

nodes.label: Model Serving & Management
nodes.title: Model Serving & Management
nodes.description: The higher-level module that orchestrates model loading, scheduling, and API interactions.

groups.label: Model Lifecycle Management
groups.title: Model Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Handles the entire lifecycle of models, from their initial creation and optimization to their efficient execution and state management.

groups.label: Specialized Engines
groups.title: Specialized Engines
groups.description: Provides dedicated engines for specific functionalities like image generation and external tool integration.

groups.label: Foundational Components
groups.title: Foundational Components
groups.description: Contains the basic building blocks and core algorithms for neural network operations.

groups.label: Integration Point
groups.title: Integration Point
groups.description: The primary module that integrates and orchestrates the low-level model operations for external consumption.
